mapper.select: SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, NVL(p.discount_rate, 0) AS discountRate, pi.image_url AS imageUrl FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON p.product_no = pi.product_no AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY p.product_no DESC

SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, NVL(p.discount_rate, 0) AS discountRate, pi.image_url AS imageUrl, p.category_id AS categoryId, p.same_day_delivery_yn AS sameDayDeliveryYn FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON pi.product_no = p.product_no AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y'
AND p.category_id IN ( SELECT c.category_id FROM category c WHERE c.use_yn = 'Y' START WITH c.category_id = #{categoryId} CONNECT BY PRIOR c.category_id = c.parent_id )
AND p.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND NVL(p.discount_rate, 0) > 0
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.product_no DESC
ORDER BY NVL(p.discount_rate, 0) DESC, p.created_at DESC
ORDER BY p.view_count DESC, p.product_no DESC
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.product_no DESC

SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, NVL(p.discount_rate, 0) AS discountRate, pi.image_url AS imageUrl, p.same_day_delivery_yn AS sameDayDeliveryYn FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON pi.product_no = p.product_no AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.product_no DESC FETCH FIRST 8 ROWS ONLY

SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, NVL(p.discount_rate, 0) AS discountRate, pi.image_url AS imageUrl, p.same_day_delivery_yn AS sameDayDeliveryYn FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON pi.product_no = p.product_no AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY p.view_count DESC, p.product_no DESC FETCH FIRST 8 ROWS ONLY

SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, NVL(p.discount_rate, 0) AS discountRate, pi.image_url AS imageUrl, p.same_day_delivery_yn AS sameDayDeliveryYn FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON pi.product_no = p.product_no AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' AND NVL(p.discount_rate, 0) > 0 ORDER BY NVL(p.discount_rate, 0) DESC, p.created_at DESC FETCH FIRST 8 ROWS ONLY

SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, NVL(p.discount_rate, 0) AS discountRate, pi.image_url AS imageUrl, p.same_day_delivery_yn AS sameDayDeliveryYn FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON pi.product_no = p.product_no AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE FETCH FIRST 8 ROWS ONLY
